units: <cite ref="Eruvin 100a:4">Erub. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>דדמו כמ׳</he> (some ed. … <he>ניתה</he>; Ms. M. <he>כי שִׁינִּיתָא</he>) if the roots on the surface are shaped like a jaw-bone (Rashi: ‘rocky crag’, v. infra).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:7">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> <he>מ׳ דימא וכ׳</he> the bluffs at Caesarea; (<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:1">Koh. R. to XI, 1</cite> <cite ref="U00470"><he>שוניתא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:8">ib. to V, 8</cite> <cite ref="U00472"><he>שונתא</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Taanit 23a:16">Taan. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>אהדרא ליה מ׳</he> a grotto formed around him; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 126:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXVI</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 108b:14">B. Mets. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>אפסיק מ׳</he> if a craggy mound separated the fields.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 109a:12">Ib. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>אהדר ליה מ׳</he> he surrounded the fields with an embankment.
